newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: POLL-Peronist Duhalde leads Buenos Aires race.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Peronist Duhalde leads Buenos Aires race.

text.p: Governing Peronist Party candidate Hilda Duhalde leads in the race for the lower house seat for Buenos Aires province in Argentina's mid-term Congressional elections, according to an opinion poll published Monday.
The elections will be held in mid-October.
Duhalde attracted 31 percent support in the survey by private pollsters Mori Argentina, published in the El Cronista financial daily.
Second was Graciela Fernandez Meijide, of the center-left Frepaso alliance, with 28 percent support, ahead of former Argentine President Raul Alfonsin, of the Radical Party, with 18 percent.
Other voters supported minor candidates, were undecided, or said they would not vote.
A third of Argentine voters live in Buenos Aires province.
The poll of 1,000 elegible voters was taken from June 14-28. El Cronista did not report its margin of error.
